home_hint: Unlock a vault to use it in Explorer and your apps.
empty_title: A private place for your files
empty_hint: Create your first vault, or open an existing vault folder.
create_hint: Choose a new folder and a strong password (at least 12 characters).
open_hint: Select the folder containing header.json. Your files stay encrypted.
recovery_warning: No password reset. Keep a backup of the entire locked vault.
single_writer: Cloud folder? Unlock on only one device at a time; let sync finish first.
confirm_ack: I understand that a lost password cannot be recovered.
idle_hint: Locking waits for apps to close their files. The tray stays available.
update_current: You have the latest stable version.
update_failed: Update unavailable. The repository, network, asset or verification may be unavailable. Try again later.
install_lock_first: Lock every drive before installing an update.
footer_tray: Closing this window keeps your drives in the tray.
runtime_missing: Drive support is unavailable. Install the official Dokany 2.3.1+ runtime separately.
runtime_ready: Drive support detected. Driver compatibility is checked when unlocking.
recovery_text: There is no recovery key or password reset. Restore a complete locked-vault backup if data is damaged; you still need its password.
created: Vault created. Your original files were not changed.
added: Vault added. Unlock it when you need your files.
forgotten: Removed from this list. The vault folder is unchanged.
exit_blocked: Some files are still open. Close them and try Quit again.
queue_full: Another operation is still finishing. Try again shortly.
error_auth: Incorrect password, or encrypted data has been changed.
error_format: The vault format is damaged or unsupported. Preserve your backup.
error_writer: This vault is already open elsewhere. Close the other writer first.
error_path: Choose a valid absolute folder path without links or reparse points.
error_notfound: The vault or file was not found. Check the folder location.
error_exists: That folder or name already exists. Choose a new location.
error_sharing: Another app is using this file. Close it and retry.
error_delete: The file is waiting for its open handles to close.
error_handles: Close files and Explorer windows using this drive, then retry Lock.
error_locked: The drive is locking or already locked.
error_access: The operation is not permitted. Check permissions and read-only files.
error_size: The request exceeds the supported size.
error_runtime: Drive support is missing or incompatible. Install Dokany 2.3.1+ separately.
error_mount: The drive could not be connected or safely disconnected. Its state is retained; retry after closing files.
error_update: Update verification or installation failed. Your current installation was preserved.
error_storage: Storage is unavailable or an operation failed. Check free space and folder permissions.
error_preferences: Settings could not be read or saved. Existing files were preserved.
error_password_short: Use a password with at least 12 characters.
error_password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
error_ack: Confirm that you understand the password recovery limit.
error_alias: Enter a short name for this vault.
error_drive: No free drive letter is available. Free a letter and retry.
folder_picker: Choose a vault folder (a new folder when creating)
